youtube.title: Morning Prayer for Today | Psalm 37:5 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Got plans today? Hand them over first.

"Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass." Psalm 37:5 (KJV)

Committing it means you stop carrying it around in your pocket all day.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
